platform_boundary_rule: sahool-platform may proxy or consume raster facts, but must not own raster computation/state

allowed_platform_files.api/imagery_automation.py: service_client: triggers raster-service scene search/process-from-stac after field geometry changes
allowed_platform_files.api/routers/automation.py: facade_proxy: imagery automation endpoints registered as raster-service target owner
allowed_platform_files.api/routers/compat_gateway.py: legacy_compat: temporary passthrough for misrouted /api/raster and /api/vegetation paths
allowed_platform_files.api/routers/confidence.py: aggregation_consumer: NDVI confidence endpoint classified as raster-service extraction target
allowed_platform_files.api/routers/etc_dual.py: aggregation_consumer: consumes fresh NDVI grid from raster-service for ETc calculation
allowed_platform_files.api/routers/field_ai_context.py: aggregation_consumer: reads raster facts for AI context packs
allowed_platform_files.api/routers/field_intelligence.py: aggregation_consumer: field card reads raster facts and provider/terrain status
allowed_platform_files.api/routers/gis_cloud_native.py: legacy_compat: cloud-native GIS/STAC endpoints marked for raster-service extraction
allowed_platform_files.api/routers/ndvi_analysis.py: facade_proxy: NDVI analysis endpoint marked for raster-service extraction
allowed_platform_files.api/routers/weather.py: legacy_compat: weather tile cache endpoints marked for extraction; final owner to split between weather-service and raster tile cache
allowed_platform_files.api/spatial_sync.py: field_geometry_signal: emits/stores raster cache stale markers when geometry changes
allowed_platform_files.api/cost_governance.py: cost_accounting: declares raster-service cost profile, not raster computation
allowed_platform_files.api/event_bus.py: event_contracts: contains raster event comments/contracts, not computation
allowed_platform_files.api/routers/regional_bulletin.py: aggregation_consumer: reads zonal_stats for regional bulletin until summary endpoint exists
